pages.heading: Scaffolding safety.
pages.intro: Guardrails, base plates, planking and tie-ins are what separate a working platform from a hazard.
pages.seoTitle: Scaffolding Safety | Scaffolding Rental Los Angeles
pages.seoDescription: Scaffolding safety basics for rented frame, tube and clamp, and rolling scaffolding in Los Angeles.

sections.heading: Level base, full planking, guardrails.
sections.body: Scaffolding fails at the bottom far more often than at the top. A level, load-bearing base with proper plates, full planking at every working level, and guardrails where anyone can fall are the three things worth checking before the first person climbs.
